subject: Kickoff: MAP foundation + Week0 slides for Tidewell evaluation
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Heidi Warner <heidi.warner@tidewell.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: MAP foundation + Week0 slides for Tidewell evaluation

Heidi —

Great to meet you yesterday. Per our conversation, I put together a short seed MAP (mutual action plan) that outlines a compact Week0 -> Week4 evaluation plan, key stakeholders, and checkpoints we recommend for a successful pilot. The doc includes:

- Week0: kickoff + access + quick smoke tests
- Week1: integration validation + latency/cost baseline
- Week2–3: feature validation + QA prompts
- Week4: acceptance criteria + exec review and next steps

Please take a look and comment where you want different pacing. Also helpful: can you confirm the technical lead and security reviewer on your side so we can add owners to the plan?

Link to MAP seed (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/seed-map-tidewell
Attachment: MAP_seed_v1.gdoc (Google Doc stub)

If that format works, I can follow up with a 2-slide exec brief for your leadership and a 1-page SOC2 checkpoint table.

Thanks — happy to adjust based on your priorities.

— David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Schedule: https://cal.me/david-kim

From: Heidi Warner <heidi.warner@tidewell.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@tidewell.com, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 13:42:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP foundation + Week0 slides for Tidewell evaluation

David —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. I skimmed the MAP and it looks like a solid starting point. A couple quick asks before we finalize: 

1) We need an explicit security/compliance checkpoint early in Week0 — our InfoSec team requires a short evidence list (SOC2, data retention settings, encryption in transit at a minimum). Can you attach a one-page table mapping what Redwood will provide vs what we need to verify?
2) Can you produce a 2-slide executive summary (problem statement, success criteria, timeline + ask) that I can share with our VP of Digital Ops?
3) Preferred kickoff window: next Tue/Wed morning (EST). I included procurement to start contract discussions in parallel.

I also left a couple inline comments on the doc about latency expectations.

On Thu, Nov 20, 2025 at 9:05 AM David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Heidi —
> 
> Great to meet you yesterday. Per our conversation, I put together a short seed MAP ...

Best,
Heidi Warner
Director, Platform Integrations | Tidewell Health
heidi.warner@tidewell.com

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Heidi Warner <heidi.warner@tidewell.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 15:02:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff: MAP foundation + Week0 slides for Tidewell evaluation (internal ops)

Team —

Heidi asked for two quick artifacts: (A) a one-page SOC2/evidence mapping table and (B) a 2-slide exec brief for VP-level review. Can we split these today?

Priyom — can you draft the SOC2 evidence table (knit to our public compliance page + what we can deliver for the pilot). Keep it short — one table with owners.
Marissa — can you draft a 2-slide slide deck (one slide problem/success criteria + one slide timeline + asks)? Use our slide template and keep bullets short.
Jasmine — please add latency baseline and expected test harness details into Week1 slot on the MAP doc.

Heidi prefers kickoff Tue/Wed morning EST; let’s pencil Tue 11/25 10:30am EST but I’ll wait to confirm after team availability.

Thanks — small deliverables, quick turnaround. I’ll stitch the updates back into the MAP doc and send to Heidi.

— David

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff: MAP foundation + Week0 slides for Tidewell evaluation (exec brief draft)

Folks —

Attached draft 2-slide exec brief and an updated MAP that pulls in the SOC2 checkpoint row and latency baseline notes Jasmine added. Quick notes:

- Slide 1: Situation + success criteria (kept to three bullets)
- Slide 2: 4-week timeline + who owns each checkpoint (ops, infra, security)

Attachments: Tidewell_exec_brief.pptx (slide deck stub); MAP_seed_v1_updated.gdoc (Google Doc stub)

I highlighted the items I want you to sanity-check: SOC2 evidence items (Priyom), timeline owners (David/Jasmine). If we can approve by EOD Friday PST I can send to Heidi first thing Monday morning.

— Marissa
Product Marketing | Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Heidi Warner <heidi.warner@tidewell.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@tidewell.com
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Finalized MAP seed + exec brief + kickoff proposal (links)

Heidi —

Thanks for the rapid feedback. We updated the MAP to include a Week0 SOC2 evidence checkpoint and added latency baselines per your comments. I attached the 2-slide exec brief Marissa prepared and a short SOC2 mapping Priyom pulled together.

Links/attachments:
- MAP (final seed): https://docs.google.com/document/d/seed-map-tidewell
- Exec brief (slides): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/tidewell-exec-brief
- SOC2 evidence table (inline in MAP): see Week0 > security checklist
- Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=tidewell-kickoff

Proposed kickoff: Tue 2025-11-25 10:30 AM EST (30–45m). If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short agenda (introductions, access checklist, smoke test plan, acceptance criteria).
